reported_or_documented_fact: User reports 1.50 m cantilevers of eave beams toward the terraces at the top level.
model_requirement: Locate and classify each cantilever; determine structural section/reinforcement; include its self-weight and supported load tributary area in the as-built model.
note: Do not conflate with the separate G1 1.50 m projecting member ETW-FLT-E03.

reported_or_documented_fact: User reports that the 1.50 m eave-beam cantilevers enabled outward displacement of the infill line, increasing useful interior floor area.
model_requirement: Reconstruct actual infill line versus historical calculation line; evaluate permanent nonstructural load, seismic mass and any eccentricity/load-distribution consequences after documentary confirmation.
note: Configuration effect is reported; quantitative load effect remains to calculate after geometry is confirmed.

reported_or_documented_fact: User reports three apartments at the top level, each with a terrace, with usable area increased by the outward infill shift.
model_requirement: Segment the top-level plan into interior floor and terrace areas for each wing/apartment; assign correct current load categories and masses only after geometric confirmation.
note: Architectural source is expected to be decisive for plan-use geometry but not for reinforcement.

reported_or_documented_fact: User reports that the added/shifted top-level configuration and related loads were not considered in the original calculations.
model_requirement: Compare historical load take-down and frame input with confirmed as-built geometry; create explicit delta-load ledger rather than altering historical values.
note: Historical model and as-built/current model must remain separate and comparable.

reported_or_documented_fact: User reports shaped/cemented floor balconies identifiable from architectural plans.
model_requirement: Inventory geometry level by level; classify as slab cantilever/edge beam/cornice or mixed system; search reinforcement sheets; calculate self-weight, finishes, parapets/infill where applicable and live loads only after source-based geometry is fixed.
note: If reinforcement is not found it remains ND; architectural geometry cannot be used to invent bars.

reported_or_documented_fact: User reports that the shaped balconies and their effects were not considered in the original calculations.
model_requirement: Cross-check every balcony identified architecturally against historical frame/load inputs and create explicit omitted-load/eccentricity/mass residuals where confirmed.
note: Do not modify the historical model retrospectively; preserve a delta between historical assumptions and as-built/current state.

reported_or_documented_fact: User notes that the original technician worked schematically and recurrently, often simplifying without explicitly considering effects of the simplification.
model_requirement: Use as an autonomous search heuristic: compare recurring schemes against architecture/carpentry/reinforcement/calculation and flag divergences. Never use the heuristic itself to fill missing values.
note: This is a reverse-engineering rule, not evidence for a specific member, load or reinforcement value.
